Trump Builds Financial Trap Around Millions of Migrants (by Pablo Manríquez). The One Big Beautiful Bill Act isn't just a spending package — it's infrastructure for a debt-collection machine targeting people who missed a court date, sought medical protection, or simply showed u

Pregnant, Indicted, and Not Backing Down: McIver Returns to Delaney Hall (EXCLUSIVE)  (by Pablo Manríquez). The Trump administration charged her with a felony for showing up. She showed up again to fight for migrant rights and close an infamous for-profit detention center in New Jersey.
Good Morning From Beantown (by Pablo Manríquez)

"100% Against ICE." She Ran the Ad. We Pulled the Record. (by Pablo Manríquez). Rep. April McClain Delaney was the only Maryland Democrat who voted for the Laken Riley Act. Now it seems she wishes she hadn't.

GEO Group Handed $250,000 in Dark Money to a Group Run by Jim Jordan's Former Chief of Staff  (by Pablo Manríquez). POGO's Nick Schwellenbach broke the story of GEO Group's $250K dark money donation to a Jim Jordan-aligned group in POGO Reports.
Join my subscriber chat (by Pablo Manríquez). A private space for paid subscirbers to converse and connect

SUNDAY COLUMN: Nobody Kept Score. Now Nobody Knows How to Put It Back Together. (by Pablo Manríquez). The federal government was dismantled in plain sight. No one documented it. Now there's no map to put it back together.

USCIS Declares Green Card Process a 'Privilege,' Not a Right — Attorneys Promise Court Fight (by Pablo Manríquez). A new policy memo reframes adjustment of status as 'administrative grace' — a term attorneys say misreads the law and sets up an inevitable court challenge.

CBP's New $17 Fingerprint Tax (SCOOP)  (by Pablo Manríquez). Airport workers — not travelers — will pay a new biometric fee to access customs security zones starting this summer. The government did the math. We did the reporting.

CAUGHT ON TAPE: Congressional Candidate Laurie Buckhout Invoked Pentagon General During DUI Arrest (Exclusive)  (by Pablo Manríquez). Body cam footage shows retired Army colonel telling Georgia officer a two-star asked her to "stay late" before her arrest.

ICE Spent More in January Than NASA Gets All Year (by Pablo Manríquez). New budget analysis shows a $7.3 billion outlay spike — seven times the monthly average — as the government moves to quadruple detention capacity with no public project-level accounting.

SCOOP: ICE Moves to Hike Deportation Stay Fee by 387 Percent  (by Pablo Manríquez). The agency hasn’t touched the fee since 1989. Now it wants to charge $755 to people with final removal orders — many of them sick, broke, or both.

Senate Parliamentarian Kills Core of Republicans' ICE Funding Package (by Pablo Manríquez). Senate rulekeeper strips CBP appropriations and $2.5B DHS fund, citing conflicts with child protection laws — and the Trump administration's own record.

USCIS Rewrites the Rules on Deferred Action — and Immigrant Children Pay the Price (by Pablo Manríquez). A sweeping rewrite of federal deferred action rules ends automatic deportation relief for 200,000 Special Immigrant Juveniles — and hands officers broad new grounds to deny

The Man Who Built the Cages Now Runs the Agency (by Pablo Manríquez). David Venturella spent a decade at GEO Group. Now he's acting ICE director. For migrant communities, that's not a coincidence — it's the point.
ACLU's Maribel Hernández Rivera:  La Constitución define Americano, no el presidente.

Jessica Craven discusses the importance of birthright citizenship outside the Supreme Court, emphasizing that individuals born in the United States belong here. She expresses her support for those who question their place, reinforcing the principles of the 14th amendment. This discussion provides a compelling perspective on constitutional law and us citizenship.
In case anyone here is interested in my art making. Otherwise I'll just post news. Nbd
Christian Maldonado joined ACLU outside of the Supreme Court on Wednesday where the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in the birthright citizenship case Barbara v Trump.
